name: mod-menu
description: Owns /mod-menu, which hides or shows the panel pills above the prompt; each panel mod draws its own entry there

labels.title: Menu labels
labels.description: always draws each menu entry with its icon and its name. never draws the icon alone, which fits more entries in a narrow window; it applies on Nerd Font icons only, since safe mode has no icon. /mod-menu labels always|never sets it too
